nodes.label: TablePageShell UI Pattern
nodes.rationale: All list/table pages use TablePageShell for consistent shell header, description, and action button placement, avoiding duplicate styling layers.

nodes.label: CITrainingPackageAssignment Backend Model
nodes.rationale: Uses CI-specific assignment model (not catalog packages) so each instructor gets personalized package coverage. Ensures full CI training level coverage per instructor before bootstrap.

nodes.label: CI Package Purchase Validation (assignment-based)
nodes.rationale: Purchase validation uses assignment IDs, not catalog IDs, ensuring CI can only purchase packages assigned to them by admin.

nodes.label: Extended StudentLevelProgression Model (certificateStatus enum)
nodes.rationale: Replaces certificateIssued:boolean with certificateStatus:enum('NONE'|'PENDING'|'ISSUED'|'REJECTED') plus four new columns to unify certificate data into SLP; removes separate Certificate entity to eliminate data duplication.

nodes.label: CertificateIssuanceService (thin facade over SLP)
nodes.rationale: Controller contract preserved; internals now delegate to StudentLevelProgressionService to avoid breaking existing API consumers.

nodes.label: Student Level Progression Frontend UI Plan (2026-05-10)
MultiSelectDropdown Component (components/shared/MultiSelectDropdown.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Replaces scrollable checkbox list in order dialogs with a searchable Popover+Command dropdown. No new dependencies — uses existing shadcn/ui Popover and Command primitives.

nodes.label: StudentLevelProgression Lifecycle (6 stages)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors CITraining pattern: Enrollment creates row, order sets materialsOrdered, marks entry progresses status, completion advances level, certificate issuance closes the cycle. Enables per-level history and duplicate-order blocking.

nodes.label: Student Order Blocking via materialsOrdered Flag
nodes.rationale: Filters eligibleStudents = isActive && !materialsOrdered, mirroring the existing CI material request blocking pattern.

nodes.label: Three-Section Inventory Panel Layout
nodes.rationale: Section 1 = already-linked (parent renders), Section 2 = pending selections (unsaved, inside panel), Section 3 = searchable catalog (inside panel). Order correction needed because inventory-section.tsx previously reversed Section 1 and 2+3.

nodes.label: InventoryCheckboxLinkPanel (original bulk-link design)
nodes.rationale: Replaces one-item-at-a-time popover+combobox flow with checkbox multi-select + inline qty + single Save. Dirty-only send: only newly-checked items go to backend.

hyperedges.label: Inventory Bulk Link & Checkbox Panel Feature
